title: Flame-retardant effect of a novel phosphaphenanthrene/triazine-trione bi-group compound on an epoxy thermoset and its pyrolysis behaviour
abstract: A novel phosphaphenanthrene/triazine-trione bi-group flame retardant TOD, containing two different chemical bridge bonds (aliphatic and aromatic) between flame-retarding groups, was synthesized to prepare satisfactory flame-retardant epoxy thermoset.
